thread:
rachel: Quick flag: dashboard top-card shows p50/p95/p99 for /v1/stream as 40/120/300ms but when I drill into north-america the p99 is 820ms. Anyone else seeing this?

sam: What's the sample_count on both views? small slices + t-digest merges usually cause odd tails.

rachel: Top-card sample_count=33k, na slice sample_count=420.

jin: Dumped results:
```
select region, sample_count, p50, p95, p99 from latency_rollups
where endpoint='/v1/stream' and ts between 1731234400 and 1731234560;
-- global 33000 38 120 300
-- na 420 40 180 820
```

sam: I see a routing fallback event around 1731234488 in the logs that mapped a small set of tenants to the cpu variant. That would concentrate a bad tail in a small slice.

ops-bot: routing: fallback detected tenant=enterprise-x route=/v1/stream at=1731234488 reason=reserved_quota_exhausted fallback=cpu-fallback-v2

rachel: From a product perspective this is misleading. On-call looks at top-level p99 and thinks everything's fine. We need better visibility and guidance.

jin: Short-term UX: show sample_count inline on the top-card percentiles, and add a "tail-skew" indicator if a single slice contributes >35% of global p99. Also add link to explanation: "Why p99 differs across views".

sam: Infrastructure wise we should avoid trusting merged t-digests from tiny slices. Propose: when computing comparative percentiles for dashboard cards, if any contributing slice has sample_count < 1000, compute that slice's percentile from raw samples before merging. Filing INFRA-4419.

rachel: Prioritization: can UX do badge + tooltip this sprint and infra tackle raw-sample fallback next?

jin: Yep. I'll open a small PR to add sample badge + skew icon + tooltip. Assigning copy to @sam.

sam: I'll draft the tooltip: "Top-level percentiles are derived from merged t-digests. Small slice counts can distort tails. Click to inspect per-region breakdown or check routing fallback events."

ops-bot: deploy: console PR #902 canary -> 20% in 10m (adds sample_count badge and skew indicator).

sam: INFRA-4419 created: "raw-sample fallback for low-count slices used in dashboard percentile merges" with threshold=1000; adding tests and alerting.

rachel: Action items:
- jin: land UI badge + skew indicator + tooltip (PR #902)
- sam: write tooltip copy & INFRA-4419 follow-up
- jin: add chart annotation hook for routing fallback events
- rachel: update runbook with checklist: check sample_count, check routing fallback events, expand per-slice drilldown queries

Follow-up: reconvene at 1731234800 to validate fixes and close ticket. :thumbsup:
